preconditions.description: The input string S has a length between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.
The string S contains only lowercase English letters.
The number of queries Q is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= L1 <= R1 <= len(S) and 1 <= L2 <= R2 <= len(S) for L1, R1, L2, R2 in queries)
preconditions.description: For every query, the indices L1, R1, L2, R2 are 1-based and valid within the bounds of S, with L1 <= R1 and L2 <= R2.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly Q lines, one for each query.

postconditions.expression: all((output_lines[i] == 'Yes' and S[queries[i][0]-1:queries[i][1]] == S[queries[i][2]-1:queries[i][3]]) or (output_lines[i] == 'No' and S[queries[i][0]-1:queries[i][1]] != S[queries[i][2]-1:queries[i][3]]) for i in range(Q))
postconditions.description: For each query i, the output is 'Yes' if the substring from L1 to R1 equals the substring from L2 to R2 (using 1-based indexing converted to 0-based slicing), and 'No' otherwise.
